# PFTrack

> PFTrack by The Pixel Farm is a spatial intelligence platform for camera tracking, matchmoving, photogrammetry, and 3D scene reconstruction for VFX workflows.

PFTrack offers solutions from PFTrack Solo for beginners to PFTrack Enterprise with Python/PySide2 scripting capabilities. The platform integrates with industry-standard tools like Maya and provides comprehensive camera solving, lens distortion calibration, and automated tracking features for visual effects artists.

## Key Topics

- Camera tracking and matchmoving
- Lens distortion calibration (barrel and pincushion)
- PFTrack Solo and PFTrack Enterprise
- Auto Track and User Track features
- Tracking trees and presets
- Camera solver workflows
- Photogrammetry and scene reconstruction
- Python and PySide2 scripting
- Field of view and sensor size metadata
- VFX Camera Database integration
- Maya 2026 compatibility
- Feature tracking methods
- Camera sensor formats (Super 35)
- Matchmove Machine
- Visual effects pipeline integration

- [Tutorial 01 - Introduction to PFTrack & creating a project](https://www.pftrack.com/post/tutorial-01-intro-to-pftrack-creating-a-project): Beginner tutorial: creating first PFTrack project and UI overview

## Tracking and Solving Tutorials

- [Tutorial 02 - The basics of tracking & solving a clip](https://www.pftrack.com/post/tutorial-02-the-basics-of-tracking-solving-a-clip): Basic tutorial on tracking and solving clips with PFTrack camera solver

- [Tracking Trees: Basic Presets](https://www.pftrack.com/post/tracking-trees-basic-presets): Basic tracking tree presets for camera and object solving workflows

## Camera and Lens Fundamentals

- [Sensor Size: A Practical Guide for Camera Tracking](https://www.pftrack.com/post/sensor-size-a-practical-guide-for-camera-tracking): Guide to sensor size terminology and metadata for camera tracking projects
- [Why you need to know about distortion calibration](https://www.pftrack.com/post/why-you-need-to-know-about-distortion-calibration): Explains lens distortion calibration process for camera tracking workflows
